en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a large European-style public square with a central circular fountain and trees, surrounded by multi‑story neoclassical buildings. Horse‑drawn carriages and early motor vehicles are visible, along with people walking around the plaza. At the top of the image appears a printed caption in French that identifies the location as Alexandrie and the specific square. A watermark with a website URL is printed across the lower-right area.
